basic_details.job_title: CMRL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 General Manager, Deputy General Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL), a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Tamil Nadu, has invited online applications for 6 posts on contract / deputation basis, one vacancy each, at a consolidated pay of Rs.75,000 to Rs.2,25,000 per month. The posts are General Manager (Underground Construction), two Deputy General Manager posts, two Manager posts and one Deputy Manager post. All require B.E / B.Tech or B.Arch with post-qualification executive experience. Applications are accepted only on https://careers.chennaimetrorail.org/ on or before 15 December 2026, under Noti

A separate last date for fee payment is not printed; the application deadline is 15-12-2026.

content_sections.heading: About CMRL
content_sections.text: Chennai Metro Rail Limited, with its office at Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai - 600 035, is described in the notice as a special purpose vehicle (SPV) entrusted with implementing the Metro Rail Project in the city of Chennai. It is a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Tamil Nadu. The notice is signed by the Chief General Manager (HR & Legal).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 posts with one vacancy each, so the total is 6. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up. CMRL may cancel, curtail or increase the number of vacancies without notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Every degree must be from a Govt. recognized University / Institute, approved by AICTE / UGC. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Age, qualification and experience are counted as on 25-11-2026. The experience required depends on where the applicant currently works: Government organisation, Metros / PSUs, or private sector. Government organisation: an officer in Senior Administrative Grade (SAG) / Non-Functional Senior Administrative Grade (NF-SAG) in Railways or equivalent in GoI, or an officer working as Chief Engineer in State Govt organisations. Metros / PSUs: minimum 20 years of post-qualification executive experience and at least 3 years as AGM in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 100000 - 260000 or equivalent pay. Private sector: minimum 20 years of post-qualification executive experience and at least 3 years in top management positions (equivalent to AGM in PSU), reporting directly to a Director or Board. The company must have a project size of not less than Rs.500 Crore or an annual turnover of not less than Rs.100 Crore in the last 3 years, with documentary proof uploaded online. Experience: execution of large infrastructure projects of Underground Tunnel / construction of Underground station with diaphragm wall, monitoring General Consultant / contractor performance, coordination with Government agencies, familiarity with Contract Management / FIDIC contracts, and exposure to QA / QC and safety monitoring systems. Out of the 20 years, a minimum of 5 years in underground metro construction, either Tunnel (TBM) or UG station works, is essential. Government organisation: an officer with 3 years of service in Senior Time Scale (STS) in Railways or equivalent in GoI, or an officer in Executive Engineer cadre in State Govt organisations, with minimum 13 years of post-qualification executive experience. Metros / PSUs: minimum 13 years of post-qualification executive experience and at least 4 years as Manager in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 70000 - 200000 or equivalent pay. Private sector: minimum 13 years of post-qualification executive experience and at least 4 years in middle management (equivalent to Manager in PSU), reporting to senior management. The company must have a project size of not less than Rs.500 Crore or an annual turnover of not less than Rs.100 Crore in the last 3 years, with proof uploaded online. Experience: major infrastructure (such as Metro Rail, Railways) or large-scale development projects, in design and development of Metro stations, property development design and its integration with stations, sustainable design and green building technologies, and transit oriented development principles. The incumbent should be conversant with norms such as TNCDBR, NBC/NFPA, CRZ, EC, and proficient in software such as AutoCAD and BIM. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay in the vacancy table is consolidated pay per month for contract / deputation. A deputationist has the option either to draw the pay drawn in the parent organisation with deputation allowance and project allowance at 10% of Basic Pay each, or to draw the equivalent cadre IDA pay scale in CMRL with IDA, HRA and Cafeteria Allowance (31.5% of Basic Pay). Contract appointment is initially for 2 years and may be extended subject to requirement and performance, on mutual consent. Deputation is initially for 3 years, extendable up to 5 years. Selected candidates on contract may be considered for IDA Pay Scale on contract basis after satisfactory completion of 2 years, depending on CMRL requirement and performance. Applicants applying through proper channel from Govt / PSUs with minimum 2 years in regular pay scale may be considered for IDA Pay on contract basis directly on selection, as per CMRL policy. Apart from consolidated pay, Medical and Personal Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, Mobile Phone reimbursement and SIM Card for official use, and other admissible allowances as per CMRL HR policy shall be paid. Higher remuneration or a higher post may be considered based on past experience, interview performance, higher qualification and exceptional credentials.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection methodology has two stages: interview, followed by a medical examination. It judges knowledge, skills, comprehension, attitude, aptitude and physical fitness. Meeting the qualification and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. Only short-listed candidates are notified for interview, and CMRL reserves the right to shortlist. Shortlisting scrutiny is based solely on the documents uploaded online. Provisionally selected candidates are intimated to appear for original certificate verification and medical examination, and must submit original certificates and related documents. CMRL bears the expense of the first-time medical examination. If a candidate seeks extension for joining, the second medical examination is at the candidate's cost. To-and-fro travel for the medical test is borne by the candidate. A candidate who fails the prescribed medical test is not given any alternative employment. Success in selection confers no right to appointment unless CMRL is satisfied about the candidate's character and antecedents. No TA / DA is paid by CMRL for attending the interview. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies, one each for General Manager (Underground Construction), Deputy General Manager (Architect), Deputy General Manager (Contract Procurement), Manager (Architect), Manager (Power Supply & Overhead Equipment) and Deputy Manager (Power Supply & Overhead Equipment).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application with the requisite documents must be submitted on or before 15-12-2026 (15 December 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for CMRL posts?
faq.answer: General Manager (Underground Construction) needs B.E / B.Tech (Civil). Both Architect posts need B.Arch. DGM (Contract Procurement) needs B.E / B.Tech (Civil/Mech/ECE/EEE). Both Power Supply & Overhead Equipment posts need B.E / B.Tech (EEE). Post-qualification experience is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years for General Manager, 40 years for both DGM posts, 38 years for both Manager posts and 35 years for Deputy Manager, as on 25-11-2026. SC/ST get 5 years, MBC/DC/BC get 2 years, and the total after relaxation cannot exceed 58 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for CMRL contract / deputation posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay per month is Rs.2,25,000 for General Manager, Rs.1,25,000 for each DGM post, Rs.85,000 for each Manager post and Rs.75,000 for Deputy Manager. Medical and accident insurance, life insurance and mobile reimbursement are also paid.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Unreserved and other category candidates pay Rs.300 and SC/ST candidates pay Rs.50, both non-refundable. Differently Abled persons pay no fee. The fee applies only to contract type of employment.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only online at https://careers.chennaimetrorail.org/ by registering with a valid email id, verifying it and uploading the required documents. Hard copy applications are not entertained.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CMRL posts?
faq.answer: Selection is a two-stage process: interview followed by a medical examination. Only short-listed candidates are called for interview, and no TA / DA is paid for attending it.

faq.question: Q9. Are these CMRL posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract / deputation basis. Contract is initially for 2 years and may be extended. Deputation is initially for 3 years, extendable up to 5 years.

faq.answer: Yes. Such persons should apply through proper channel to [email protected] and produce an NOC at the time of interview. They also upload an NOC / Through Proper Channel letter in the online application.
